# FLX-3709: the bundle's queries were checked with another sqlglot than the one installed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

fluxsim init records the sqlglot version that compiled the consumers' queries (compiledWith). Another version may write a query's canonical text another way, so a rate taken with it is not the rate the bundle's author checked, and the fit is not started. Install the recorded version, or write the queries again with fluxsim init. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3709
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
